note: Collection evidence for the initial grouped snapshot. Fetch scripts refresh outlet rows; these source notes describe the recorded collection and its limitations.

zus-coffee.scope: Existing 601-outlet snapshot preserved without refreshing or changing rows.

luckin-coffee.scope: All Cities, public Malaysia pickup outlet locator, active status=1
luckin-coffee.coordinateSystem: Official locationLatitude/locationLongitude copied without transformation; app uses Google Maps, Malaysia does not need China GCJ-02 conversion.
limitations: Coverage includes only outlets visible in the public ordering locator. New or internal stores absent from the locator cannot be verified.
Temporarily closed outlets remain listed when their active status is 1.
The official marketing homepage says 83 Malaysia outlets as of 31 March 2026; the October live locator returns 159 and is the fresher outlet-level source.
Undocumented API transport may change; refresh script fails before writing on malformed responses.

coffee-bean-tea-leaf.scope: All 195 items from the official Malaysian web locator; advertised totalRecords matched item count.
coverageGaps: No usable current official listing found for Sabah, Sarawak or Labuan.
coffeebeaneastmalaysia.com HTTP /defaultsite is an IONOS parking page; HTTPS fails.
Source addresses/coordinates may contain further inconsistencies. Pins are source-provided, not independently surveyed.
East Coast Mall 2 published address duplicates Kuantan City Mall; preserved without inventing a replacement.
